# YomVezman 0.8.0 feature-freeze preview
App 0.8.0 (10), Apple silicon, macOS 14 or later. This is a testing prerelease, not the 0.9.0 release candidate or an App Store-approved build.
New: **View > Daily Psalms** opens an offline Hebrew reader with all 150 chapters (2,527 verses) from the explicitly selected **Tanach with Nikkud** edition, provided by Sefaria and sourced from tanach.us, labeled Public Domain. Exact text and chapter/verse references are preserved; no generated text or English translation is included.
The monthly reading follows the selected city's daytime Hebrew date. Psalm 119 is split across days 25/26; a 29-day month combines the final two portions. Previous/next-day buttons update the calendar selection. Adjust text size, or Tab into the reading area and use Up/Down by verse and Home/End to reach the beginning/end. A visible outline marks keyboard focus. No reading history is stored and no text is fetched while reading.
Source integrity, complete monthly coverage, timezone boundaries, keyboard endpoints/mixed-input scrolling, and refusal of damaged text were verified. The source passed 92 regression tests, including live Hebcal checks, and independent reviews.
Feature freeze means the next work focuses on acceptance and fixes. Spoken VoiceOver and remaining keyboard/display, minimized/status-only recovery, actual location permission denial/Stop, arbitrary map-point selection, same-process outage/retry and reset-error checks remain required before **0.9.0 RC**. Their status is unverified, not a claim of confirmed defects. App Store validation belongs to **1.0.0**. Preview publication does not close these gates. Fresh final-package UI smoke and website rendering were unavailable because the native/browser automation hosts could not connect; earlier source-native checks are recorded separately.
From 0.4.0 or later, use Check for Updates and follow the user-confirmed installation prompts. Older versions need one manual installation. The owner performs installation; no automatic or silent update is enabled.
